Experienced hire placement guidelines" (p.33), governs "newly hired teachers, with experience" and does not address prior PPS service; the "either in Pittsburgh Public Schools or from another district" phrase there concerns three years of student-growth measures for level advancement, not initial step placement.

Career Ladder Salary Schedule guideline C.1 (p.33, verified against the scan): "The step placement of newly hired teachers, with experience, shall be based upon a Salary Schedule Placement Rubric." Experienced-hire credit is therefore acknowledged but the rubric is not reproduced, no year-for-year or maximum-credit rule is stated, and out-of-state (or even out-of-district) experience is never distinguished — the nearest is that experienced hires need three years of student-growth measures "either in Pittsburgh Public Schools or from another district" before a level advancement. So the topic is touched but the "how" is absent.
